faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our travel services, bookings, payments, and more.
faq.metaTitle: FAQ | Corporate & Luxury Travel Questions | JetSet Travel Cyprus
faq.metaDescription: Common questions about corporate travel management, booking process, visa services, and luxury travel planning in Cyprus. Get answers from JetSet Travel.

booking.q1: How do I request a travel quote?
booking.a1: Contact us via our website form, WhatsApp (+357 99 478 073), or email (info@jetset.com.cy). Tell us your destination, dates, number of travelers, and preferences. We typically respond with options within 24 hours.
booking.q2: What services does JetSet Travel offer?
booking.a2: We provide corporate travel management, luxury leisure travel planning, flight and hotel bookings, visa assistance, private transfers, and 24/7 travel disruption support.
booking.a3: Yes. We manage group travel for corporate events, team retreats, and large family trips. We handle logistics, coordinated bookings, and negotiate group rates.
booking.a4: Absolutely. We have access to real-time availability and can arrange urgent travel. Contact us via WhatsApp for the fastest response.

corporate.q1: How does your corporate travel management work?
corporate.a1: We assign a dedicated account manager to your company. They handle all bookings, ensure policy compliance, provide clean invoicing for finance teams, and offer 24/7 disruption support.
corporate.a2: Yes. We provide detailed, finance-ready invoices aligned with corporate compliance requirements. Monthly statements and reporting are available for corporate accounts.
corporate.q3: What happens if there's a travel disruption?
corporate.a3: Our 24/7 support team handles rebooking, rerouting, and real-time updates via WhatsApp. We manage the disruption so your team can focus on their work.

payments.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.a1: We accept bank transfers and major credit/debit cards. Payment terms for corporate accounts can be arranged.
payments.a2: Cancellation terms vary depending on the supplier (airline, hotel, etc.). We always communicate specific terms before confirming any booking. Some bookings are non-refundable — we will make this clear upfront.
payments.a3: Travel insurance is not included but strongly recommended. We can help you find appropriate coverage for your trip.

visa.q1: What visa services do you provide?
visa.a1: We provide document checklists, application guidance, and coordination support for business and tourist visas to most countries.
visa.a2: No. Visa approval is at the discretion of the issuing authority. We maximize your chances by ensuring complete and accurate applications.
visa.q3: How long does visa processing take?
visa.a3: Processing times vary by country and visa type. Typical processing is 5–15 business days. We recommend applying at least 4–6 weeks before travel.

corporatePage.faq3Q: How do you handle urgent or last-minute bookings?

corporatePage.faq4Q: What is your cancellation and rebooking policy?
corporatePage.faq4A: We manage all cancellations and changes on your behalf at no additional service fee. You only pay any airline or hotel penalties that apply. We also proactively monitor fare changes and rebook when savings are available.

servicesPage.heroSubtitle: From flight searches and hotel bookings to visa processing and luxury itineraries — JetSet handles every detail so you don't have to.
servicesPage.introTitle: Everything You Need, Under One Roof
servicesPage.introP1: JetSet Travel Cyprus is a full-service, IATA-accredited travel agency based in Paphos. Since 2006, we have provided corporate and leisure travellers with end-to-end travel solutions — from initial fare search through to landing back home. Our team manages flights, hotels, visas, luxury holidays, and corporate travel programmes, all through a single point of contact.
servicesPage.introP2: Whether you are a finance director looking for compliant invoicing, a family planning a once-in-a-lifetime holiday, or a business traveller who needs last-minute changes handled in real time — we have built our services around your needs. Every booking is backed by our IATA accreditation, Cyprus Tourism Organisation licence, and a team that has been doing this for nearly two decades.
servicesPage.flightsP1: JetSet has direct access to all major Global Distribution Systems — including Amadeus, Galileo, and Sabre — giving us real-time availability and pricing across hundreds of airlines worldwide. Whether you need a simple return flight or a complex multi-city itinerary with mixed cabin classes, our ticketing team finds the optimal routing and fare class for your needs.
servicesPage.flightsP2: As an IATA-accredited agent, we issue tickets directly — no intermediaries, no delays. This means faster confirmations, immediate e-tickets, and the ability to handle last-minute changes or cancellations efficiently. For schedule changes or flight disruptions, we monitor your bookings proactively and rebook before you even know there is a problem.
servicesPage.flightsP3: For corporate clients, we offer access to negotiated corporate fare programmes and consolidator rates that are not available through consumer booking sites. We also manage frequent flyer programmes, seat preferences, meal requests, and special service requests across your entire organisation — all tracked through your dedicated company profile.
servicesPage.hotelsP1: Our hotel desk books accommodation across every category — from budget-friendly business hotels to five-star luxury resorts and extended-stay serviced apartments. We maintain direct relationships with major hotel groups and independent properties worldwide, giving you access to negotiated rates, room upgrades, and flexible cancellation terms that are not available on public booking sites.
servicesPage.hotelsP2: Every property we recommend has been vetted for quality, location, and guest satisfaction. We match hotels to your specific requirements — whether that is proximity to a conference venue, family-friendly amenities, wheelchair accessibility, or suite-level luxury for a special occasion. For groups and extended stays, we negotiate custom rates and manage all logistics on your behalf.
servicesPage.visasP1: Navigating visa requirements can be complicated, especially for multi-destination trips or business travel on short notice. Our visa team provides personalised document checklists tailored to your nationality and destination, reviews your application for completeness and accuracy, coordinates appointment bookings with embassies and visa application centres, and tracks your application status through to decision.
servicesPage.visasP2: We handle visa applications for all major destinations — including the Schengen Zone, United Kingdom, United States, Russia, UAE, Canada, Australia, and many more — for both tourist and business purposes. We maximise your chances of approval by ensuring complete and error-free submissions. Please note: we assist with preparation and submission, but final approval decisions rest with the issuing consulate or authority.
servicesPage.luxuryP1: For travellers who want more than a booking — they want an experience — our luxury travel consultants design bespoke itineraries tailored entirely to your preferences. From private island getaways and alpine ski chalets to cultural city breaks, wellness retreats, and adventure journeys, every trip is crafted from scratch around your wishes and travel style.
servicesPage.luxuryP2: We leverage our partnerships with premium hotel groups, private villa networks, and local concierge services to unlock perks that are not available to the general public — including complimentary upgrades, resort credits, late checkouts, and exclusive access to curated experiences. Whether it is a honeymoon, an anniversary, a family celebration, or a solo retreat, we make it extraordinary.
servicesPage.corporateP1: Managing travel for a business requires more than just bookings — it demands compliance, accountability, and cost control. Our corporate travel management service assigns a dedicated account manager to your organisation, sets up policy-compliant booking workflows, and delivers clean, VAT-ready invoicing that your finance team will appreciate.
servicesPage.corporateP2: From executive travel and team trips to conference logistics and event travel, we handle everything through a single point of contact. As an IATA-accredited agent, we issue tickets directly for faster confirmations and instant rebooking with no third-party delays. Our Cyprus-based timezone provides convenient coverage for businesses operating across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
servicesPage.ctaSubtitle: Tell us what you need — a flight quote, a hotel search, visa guidance, or a fully managed trip — and we will take it from there.
